description: The compilation includes vertical stress gradients, minimum horizontal stress gradients and stress orientation. The source explicitly links these parameters to hydrocarbon development, waste-fluid disposal, geological carbon storage and potential geothermal extraction. It reports 724 vertical-gradient measurements from 126 wells, 106 minimum-horizontal-gradient measurements from 83 wells, and 214 orientation measurements from 133 wells. These are distinct measurement groups, not disjoint well totals. The work was compiled under a 1999–2004 contract; package dates are 2015–2016. The title specifies tab-delimited data and the archive descriptor says XLS, leaving the internal representation unresolved. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue supplies the original Alberta identifiers and distribution descriptions. The source names Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs and present file access remain unverified. This record covers inspected descriptive metadata; no dataset, document, archive or linked resource body was fetched. Specific simulation uses are unstated unless described above. Unlisted fields and numerical values remain unknown.
